requirements: Independent Chart/Trade workspaces with quick fixed MARKET entry
Base quantity, empty defaults, 25/50/75/100 percent sizing and shared market confirmation preference

implementation: Retained independent Chart/Trade inputs; quick entry starts with empty quantity and no percentage. Fixed MARKET in base units without inheriting ordinary order fields.
One-way BOTH with explicit reduceOnly=false; hedge LONG/SHORT by direction and no reduceOnly. Query rejects reduction or closePosition flags.
Four account/configuration/funds reads followed by three separate signed commissionRate/leverageBrackets/openOrders GETs from the same selected EOA and shared nonces; no additional wallet.

Exact rational USDT budget with taker fee, leverage-eligible risk cap, existing position exposure and same-direction pending orders. Pending reductions consume opposite closing capacity before allowing a new one-way order to use it.
Use max(reference,mark) for risk headroom, cap by market maximum, apply percentage and floor by market step anchored at minimum; below minimum returns zero.

One 30-second deadline from the initial mark snapshot, configuration/order activity lock, stale/identity/symbol callback protection. Sizing-only read failure permits manual quantity if base context is still valid.

Buy ask/sell bid reference quotes observed locally. Shared persisted market-confirmation preference is enabled by default. Read failures require confirmation; stale reads and serial write races are handled. Cancel does not save the do-not-show choice.
Existing POST and original-client-ID GET flow, signing and send-boundary checks retained. Accepted query clears input; failure/unknown preserves it. Unknown locks editing and permits query only.

Chinese/English 320-width, 1.5 text and landscape widget coverage, independent input preservation, confirmation cancellation, preference persistence failure and ordinary market confirmation regression.
boundaries: Reference USDT sizing is not an exchange-guaranteed executable maximum; released margin, non-USDT collateral and later fills are excluded. Actual account eligibility is exchange-authoritative.
